facts.value: Transcripts from every college and university from which you earned a bachelor’s degree or higher must be sent to ASU. Official transcripts must be sent directly to ASU Admission Services from the issuing institution's records office either by mail or through a secured electronic transcript service. Emailed transcripts are not acceptable.
ASU accepts unofficial transcripts as part of the application. If you submit unofficial transcripts and are admitted, you will be required to send official transcripts to the university.

Official transcripts are original academic credentials issued by the registrar of the institution attended, bearing the original raised or colored seal of the institution and the signature of the registrar or academic official.
International students must submit proof of English proficiency. Check the provided link for acceptable exams.
Support materials may include a statement of purpose or writing sample, portfolio, CV or biographical sketch or resume. Many may be uploaded as part of the online application for admission.
Depending on your graduate program, letters of recommendation may also be requested.
If residing in the U.S. on a valid visa, provide proof of your current visa.
Arizona State University, Graduate Admission Services, PO Box 871004, Tempe, AZ 85287-1004
